title: cheilanthes pyramidalis var. arizonica
intro: Cheilanthes pyramidalis var. arizonica, commonly known as Arizona lip fern, is a type of fern plant native to the southwestern United States and northern Mexico. It is used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help to soothe digestive issues and wounds. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its ability to reduce inflammation, promote wound healing, and exhibit antimicrobial activity. The bioactive constituents of Cheilanthes pyramidalis var. arizonica include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
